feature_date_rule: Features at date t use price/return data through date t; forward targets begin at the next available observation t+1.
limitations: Gold source/instrument/market/currency are unverified; isolated and marked ineligible for training.
Government-security yield changes are not bond investment returns.
Current Nifty 50 constituents create survivorship bias.
Historical features and targets are not a guarantee of future performance.
Use chronological walk-forward validation; do not randomly split rows across time.
Rows across assets on the same date are not independent samples.
Mutual funds can overlap with Nifty 50 holdings; account for look-through exposure in portfolio optimization.

feature_descriptions.daily_return: Return from the previous available observation to this date; recomputed from adjusted close/NAV.
feature_descriptions.return_lag_1d: Daily return shifted by one observation; only prior observations.
feature_descriptions.return_lag_5d: Daily return shifted by five observations.
feature_descriptions.trailing_return_*: Compounded return over the trailing window ending on feature date.
feature_descriptions.volatility_*: Rolling sample standard deviation of daily returns, annualized by sqrt(252).
feature_descriptions.drawdown_252d: Current price/NAV relative to the trailing 252-observation high, minus one.
feature_descriptions.gsec_yield_pct: 10-year government-security yield level in percent; not a bond return.
feature_descriptions.gsec_yield_change_*: Government-security yield changes in basis points, not investment returns.
feature_descriptions.future_return_*: Compounded simple return from the next observation through the named horizon; supervised-learning target only, never a feature.
